rules: Copies in a protected deck stay there unless Zach and Steph agree otherwise.
Copies in other physically built decks can move only by agreement (negotiable).
Planned or proposed allocations (candidate lists, benches) are plans, not physical moves, and do not reduce availability.
The tools never move cards; a recommendation is never a transfer.
